messages:
maria: quick heads-up: planning a sticky-cohort delayed FF rollout for search-indexer in the 01:00 UTC window. trying to observe warm cache behavior before broad ramp.

maria: plan: deploy with flag OFF; deploy-bot -> +10m 1% (internal_sticky), +25m 5%, +50m 50%, +80m 100%. auto-pause on infra alerts; rollback+pin on error_rate>0.7% or p95_delta>80ms.

zack: can deploy-bot do sticky cohort + delayed steps?

deploy-bot: scheduled: toggle_id=tb-6500001234-01; flag=search_indexer_v3; schedule=[+10m->1%,+25m->5%,+50m->50%,+80m->100%]; sticky_cohort=internal_sticky; pause_on_alert=infra.*; rollback_triggers=[err>0.7,p95>80ms]; initiator=maria

lee: ops, please stage a router pin for eu-west if we need rollback.

ops-oncall: pin staged pin-6500001234-eu -> router->search-v2; rollback command: `deploy-bot rollback tb-6500001234-01`. dashboard link posted.

qa-bot: smoke tests `tests/smoke/search_canary.sh` will run after each step. will post results.

maria: deploying at 01:00. standby from 00:50.

(Deploy logs)
```
Deploy started: search-indexer v3
Image: registry/redwood/search:index-v3
FF search_indexer_v3=OFF
Instances: 10
Healthchecks: passing
```

qa-bot: initial smoke OK.

deploy-bot: 1% toggle executed @01:10 (internal_sticky + sampled 1%).

qa-bot: smoke @01:15: p95 +12ms, error rate 0.04%.

deploy-bot: 5% toggle executed @01:25.

ops-oncall: alert infra.search_replies_p99 triggered @01:28 -> pause.

deploy-bot: rollout paused by alert infra.search_replies_p99; awaiting manual_confirm_on_pause.

maria: pausing. can someone grab traces 01:20-01:30?

lee: traces show increased merge latency on index shard 7. looks like v3 changes to flush frequency caused extra IO.

zack: recommendation: rollback and pin. don't auto-resume tonight.

deploy-bot: rollback executed @01:40: flag search_indexer_v3=OFF; pin applied pin-6500001234-eu.

ops-oncall: pin applied and verified; traffic reverted to v2. post-rollback smoke OK.

maria: added release note: "Delayed sticky-cohort ramp paused for p99 spikes on index merges; automatic rollback executed and routing pinned to v2. Follow-up ticket #3401."

zack: retro: consider starting at 0.25% for index-heavy services and add preflight disk-IO check.

deploy-bot: tb-6500001234-01 closed: reason=manual rollback; closed_by=zack; closed_at=6500001260
